claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + directional_long_signal_family = Bull regime 100% AND UP_TRI+BULL_PROXY 100%; recommended action: Pause new entries in regime=Bull directional-long (UP_TRI and BULL_PROXY) until Bull×UP_TRI cohort promotes to Tier M or exposure diversifies via natural Day-6 exits; consider a small index-put hedge to cover the 100% long book against a Bull→Choppy/Bear flip.
